messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: INC-2026 - metering-ingest-pipeline lag detected (backfill risk). Severity: P1. Reason: aggregator consumer lag > 30m and token counts off vs upstream.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: INC-2026 has been triggered for service: metering-ingest. Assigned to: ashley. Escalation in 10m if not acknowledged. Link: https://pd.example.com/incidents/INC-2026

ashley: Acked. jumping in. seeing spike in consumer lag on `ingest-aggregator` (eu cluster). Confirming customer-facing impact: billing backlog growth and some invoice jobs flagged with inconsistent token totals.

samir: looking at consumer offsets now. consumer lag shows `consumer_group:metering-agg` lag ~45m on partition 12-14. Likely related to recent schema rollout earlier today.

nina: from billing side: a handful of upcoming invoices (tomorrow batch) have token-counts that differ by >5% compared to snapshot. If pipeline stays stalled we'll need to hold invoice generation. Can we get a mitigation?

lee: quick mitigation: flip traffic to fallback aggregator (stateless aggregator v1) while we debug v2 consumer. Will need a manual route and CDC pause. ashley can you authorize?

ashley: authorize. devon, please run the routing flip and confirm no data duplication.

devon: running traffic shift now. command:```bash
# switch aggregator output to fallback
kubectl -n metering set env deploy/aggregator AGG_MODE=fallback --record
```

ashley: pd-ack done. Also adding billing-ops to thread. @billing-ops can you freeze invoice jobs for the tomorrow batch until we confirm counts?

billing-ops: On it. Pausing scheduled invoice-run for 2027-10-02. Will tag any holds in the billing dashboard and notify customer success to prepare comms if needed.

samir: after flipping, consumer lag dropped to ~3m within 2m. Looks like v2 consumer had a shard assignment bug after the schema rollout. I can backfill missing messages from the Kafka retention for the affected partitions. ETA ~45m for backfill to converge.

nina: good. once backfill completes run a reconciliation query against the invoice preflight dataset. Sample SQL we can use:```sql
SELECT account_id, SUM(token_count) AS tokens_old, SUM(token_count) FILTER (WHERE processed_by='v2') AS tokens_v2
FROM metering.preflight
WHERE snapshot_ts >= now() - interval '2 days'
GROUP BY account_id
ORDER BY ABS(tokens_old - tokens_v2) DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

ashley: I'll own post-mortem and customer comms. devon, leave the fallback in place until samir confirms backfill + reconciliation. Then we'll do a controlled switch back with canary on 1% traffic for 30m.

devon: fallback in place. monitoring dashboards updated: `metering.ingest.lag`, `metering.invoice.delta`. Adding a temporary alert: if invoice delta > 2% for top-10 customers -> page.

lee: also adding a short-circuit in the invoice pipeline to prefer `preflight_snapshot` when `ingest_lag > 10m` to avoid miscounts. Will push a small config change (no code deploy).

ashley: handoff plan: I'm on until 1820128800 GMT. devon will take 1h watch after that. samir will own backfill. nina to validate reconciliation. If anything regresses escalate to SRE lead.

samir: backfill job started: `kafka-backfill --topic metering-events --partitions 12-14 --from-offset 123456 --to-latest` ETA ~40-50m. Posting logs to /var/logs/metering/backfill-1820126789.log.

nina: running reconciliation against a 1% sample now, looks promising — top accounts within 0.3% delta. I'll run full once backfill finishes.

billing-ops: Invoice-run remains paused. Notifying finance ops and CS. Ticket created: FIN-5489 (linked in the incident doc).

pagerduty: INC-2026 - acknowledged by ashley (oncall). Next escalation: devon in 9m.

ashley: leaving now for the handoff. devon take lead; add any updates here. tagging @lee for the short-circuit confirmation once live. :thumbsup:

devon: taking over. will monitor backfill progress and reconciliation. If backfill fails we will open a rollback/restore path and escalate. Current status: fallback aggregator active, consumer lag normal, backfill running (35% done).

incident-bot: Incident timeline note added to INC-2026. Root cause hypothesis: schema rollout introduced a shard-key change causing v2 consumer to fail assignment -> consumer lag -> token-count drift for in-flight windows.

ashley: good notes. after reconciliation and switchback we need a postmortem and a change to deployment checks (consumer assignment simulation + canary). Also add a preflight check that validates token counts before invoice windows run.

devon: backfill completed at 1820128900. reconciliation full run shows max delta 0.6% on <5 accounts; those will be manually reviewed and adjusted if needed. Re-enabling invoice pipeline with canary enabled for 1% accounts, monitoring for 2h.

nina: billing confirmed: we will resume invoice runs with canary. finance ops notified. Closing hold on FIN-5489 pending no further regressions in 2h.

ashley: closing remarks: mitigation worked, no customer-facing invoice stamps were sent with bad counts. Postmortem to be drafted in #postmortems and assigned to samir + lee. Marking incident as P1 -> mitigated.

pagerduty: INC-2026 status: mitigated. Please ensure full postmortem by EOD tomorrow.

lee: adding follow-ups to backlog: add preflight token checks, improve consumer assignment unit tests, add canary automation for aggregator swaps.

ashley: thanks everyone. good job on quick mitigation and clear handoffs. :raised_hands:
